observation: Glass impact lacks outward explosive shard motion; break reads as faint cracks with minimal debris.
expected_behavior: High-speed brick impact should generate dense radial cracking plus many shards ejecting outward with visible velocity, spin, and a debris trail behind the brick.
actual_behavior: Brick is barely readable; glass appears mostly intact with thin/faint crack lines and little-to-no visible shard ejection or secondary collapse.
